I found one blocking issue and one advisory, so the verdict is FINDINGS. Everything else in your blocking list checked clean, including all the A2 numbers on the full selftest.

- **Blocking:** a Task marked Completed with no source date still gets the import time as its completion date, and nothing records it. The same happens to a recipient-less EmailMessage with no `MessageDate`. This isn't new (the base did the same), but it is exactly the case your blocking list names. The work order doesn't say how many such rows the real extract has.
- **Advisory:** if staff reopen an imported Task, the next importer run marks it Completed again and the date becomes the time of that run, with no code.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 09ad66eb4f8cea9c69f82e7e72c47c7e4da7f03e
FINDING completed-without-source-date-stamped-now blocking: A Task whose mapped status is Completed but whose CompletedDateTime is null (or an EmailMessage imported as a Task with a null MessageDate) is sent with sfCompletedAt=null. Core DateCompleted then stamps the import-time "now", the custom hook does nothing (its `if (!$sfCompletedAt) return;` branch), and no exception code is recorded. The result is an import-time completion date that looks like real history, with no code. This is the "manufactured value (including an import-time completion date) without a code" in the WO blocking list. It is not a regression: base f26ad4e had the same behaviour on the real server. The real-extract count of Completed Tasks without CompletedDateTime is not stated in WO fact 4 | evidence: load/lib/crm_load/mapping.py:420-421 (`if attrs["status"] == "Completed": attrs["sfCompletedAt"] = completed`, with no code when completed is None); mapping.py:569 (MessageDate, same); scratch probe r/nodate.py on fx.org() with Task[0].CompletedDateTime=None gives `status Completed sfCompletedAt None dateCompleted==NOW True codes []`; with EmailMessage[1] ToAddress=None, MessageDate=None it gives `dateCompleted==NOW True codes ['activity_parent_unresolved','email_without_recipient_imported_as_task','priority_server_default']` | expected: record a counted code (e.g. `date_completed_server_stamped`) for every sent Completed Task without a source completion time, document it in IMPORT.md, test it, and have the PL confirm the real-extract count; or get an explicit PO/PL decision that accepts the core stamp
FINDING rerun-recompletes-reopened-task-with-now advisory: After staff reopen an imported Task, the next importer run PUTs {status: Completed} (status differs from the source). Core stamps "now" and the hook does not fire, because sfCompletedAt did not change. The Task ends up Completed with the importer's run time, not the Salesforce date, and no code is recorded. The hook correctly does not override a staff re-completion. The problem is that the importer re-completes with a manufactured date | evidence: scratch probe r/reopen.py on TestCrm008G.load() then PUT status "Not Started" gives `rerun writes [('PUT','Task',{'status':'Completed'})] after Completed dateCompleted==NOW True` | expected: when the importer re-applies status Completed to an existing Task, also send sfCompletedAt (so the hook restores the Salesforce date) or record a code. Alternatively, document that re-runs revert staff status edits and stamp the run time
EVIDENCE: `git -C /srv/CRM/worktrees/CRM-008-G rev-parse HEAD` = 09ad66eb4f8c… (matches the candidate); worktree is read-only, no tracked changes; the ignored __pycache__ dirs date from 23:23–23:27, before this review. `gitleaks git --log-opts="f26ad4ea..09ad66eb" --redact --no-banner` gives "1 commits scanned … no leaks found". Diff is 48 files, all inside the allowlist. entityDefs, i18n and layout change only sfCompletedAt. roles.json changes only fieldData Task.sfCompletedAt: ER Staff, Intake and Manager read yes/edit no; ER Import edit yes. The 30 access_*.json fixtures change by additions only: 120 `sfCompletedAt` blocks, each right after sfCreatedAt (90 edit no, 30 edit yes), with no other line changed. No new dependencies, downloads, CI, git hooks or engine files. The only new subprocess is the test-only `php -r` harness in tests/unit/test_activities.py, which works in a TemporaryDirectory. No delete path; new codes are ids and codes only. Hook PreserveSalesforceCompletedDate.php (BeforeSave, $order 20) copies sfCompletedAt only when the Task is new or sfCompletedAt changed; staff cannot change sfCompletedAt (fieldData), so a staff re-completion keeps core's now. Suites, run on a `git archive` copy in scratch r/wt with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1: unit "Ran 338 tests OK (skipped=1, git-metadata test)", including the php-run hook tests; load "Ran 188 tests OK"; TestCrm008G 10/10 OK. Reference extractor copied to r/ref with CONTRACT_VERSION 3→4 (the only diff); `crm-migrate selftest` (full) gives "checks=28 failed=0 status=RECONCILED". A2 (r/a2.py, FakeEspo): run-1 rc=0, writes=284, write_rejected=0; run-1 re-run writes=0; run-2 rc=0, writes=1, write_rejected=0; run-2 re-run writes=0; no Task write sent dateCompleted; Completed Tasks match=45 mismatch=0 stamped_now=0 on every load.
```
